config_fields.label: Callback URL
config_fields.description: The URL the MCP client asked events to be delivered to.

config_fields.label: Subscription ID
config_fields.description: The ID the MCP client knows the subscription by, derived from the principal, callback URL, event and arguments. It is also the destination ID.

config_fields.label: Principal
config_fields.description: The authenticated subject that created the subscription, as your MCP server identified it.

config_fields.label: Arguments
config_fields.description: The subscription arguments, as canonical JSON.

config_fields.label: Schema Hash
config_fields.description: The SHA-256 of the event's payload schema when the subscription was created or last refreshed.

credential_fields.label: Secret
credential_fields.description: Signing secret supplied by the MCP client.

credential_fields.label: Previous Secret
credential_fields.description: The secret the MCP client rotated away from. Deliveries are also signed with it until it expires.

credential_fields.label: Previous Secret Expires At
credential_fields.description: When the previous secret stops signing deliveries, in RFC 3339 format.

label: MCP Events
description: Deliver events to AI agents that subscribe through an MCP server.
